page.content:
Ordinary construction minifigure who becomes the Special in The LEGO Movie.

How Emmet Brickowski connects

  • Work: The LEGO Movie — Emmet Brickowski is the construction-worker hero of The LEGO Movie.
  • Character: Lord Business — Emmet and the Master Builders stand against Lord Business and the Kragle.
  • Character: Wyldstyle — Wyldstyle trains Emmet to build without instructions.

What is Emmet Brickowski?

Emmet Brickowski is the everyman builder of Bricksburg whose instructions-following life breaks when he is mistaken for the Master Builder who can stop Lord Business.

Key threads lead to The LEGO Movie, Lord Business and Wyldstyle.
